Cecilia and Rekka get caught in the demons' schemes, while Mizuki ventures alone into the [Breeding Dungeon] where her daughter is held. 

The harsh trials awaiting her shake Mizuki's heart and bonds... Resist and protect to the end—the epic battle to save her beloved family begins now! 

Will Mizuki and the others successfully rescue Akari? Witness the touching conclusion together.

notes.title: "BLACK SOULS II" will be released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38391122/3d2f7bab3911e08e53ebe7910d1121bae0e46be1.png[/img]
[url=https://discord.gg/yW54Vr6Q8Q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38391122/8a59d8b4fd12eafc86d6ac97c71a88434692c635.png[/img][/url]

"BLACK SOULS II" will be released!
Don't forget to add this game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3855540
[h2]GAME[/h2]
Despair. Fear, Madness, once again.
An original work based on "Alice in Wonderland" and "Through the Looking-Glass."
Dark Fairy Tale Fantasy x Psychological Horror RPG focusing on the themes of "Exploration of a Mad World" and "Life or Death Combat against Demonbeasts".

[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
●Introduction
In this work, you'll meet 45 Heroines.
Almost all of them are the fun characters you may have met before in the famous tale "Alice's Adventures in Wonderland".
Though, now all of them are charming girls.
(However, the most important for you is Alice, of course, isn't that right?)
・The White Rabbit
・The Cheshire Cat
・The Hatter
・The March Hare
・The Dormouse
・The Duchess
・The Mock Turtle
・The Gryphon
・The Queen of Hearts
・The Red Queen

And many others...

●SEN System
All NPCs in this world can be killed. However, should you do so, your SEN would decrease. And as it gets too low:
・BGM will disappear.
・All the inhabitants will begin to talk in an incomprehensible language.
・Some things that should not be seen will become visible.
What a frightening ailment it is!

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] A vast, open world made of many different and charming maps.
[*] Will you kill or will you be killed? Tactical and tense ATB combat.
[*] Explore the Wonderland end to end, gathering souls and raising your level.
[*] Death is not the end, merely a setback as you resume from the last bonfire.
[*] Many different endings
[/list]

[h2]GAME[/h2]
You awaken with no memories in a tranquil elven village devoted to worshipping the World Tree.
All the elves living here are women, and they have a unique request—they ask for your help in having children...
Embrace a leisurely slow life filled with relaxation, and enjoy your days freely bonding with the charming and distinctive elven girls!

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[h3]Relaxing Slow-Life Activities[/h3]
Engage in farming: grow a variety of crops and care for livestock to fully experience ranch life.
Experience seasonal changes in the village: enjoy gathering items, bug-catching, and fishing, along with special seasonal events.
Develop and expand the village as you progress, unlocking new features and expanding your home.

[h3]Build Relationships[/h3]
Chat with the elven girls, gift them items, and strengthen your bonds.
Deepen your connections and unlock marriage possibilities—aim to build your dream harem by marrying every girl!

[h3]Dress-Up and Customization[/h3]
Change the girls' outfits at any time, customizing colors to your preference.
Explore a wide range of outfits, including everyday wear, uniforms, and fun cosplay costumes.

[h3]Extra Content and Mini-Games[/h3]
Participate in exciting horse races with horses you've personally raised. Train your horse to become a champion in prestigious G1 races!
Take on diverse challenges to earn trophies, and proudly display your achievements in your trophy room.

Dive into this delightful world of relaxation, romance, and endless possibilities!

notes.title: [GAMER Plan]"It was a human." is now on sale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38391122/79549a30bc2b28e4cfbe649742d19c38d0307d67.jpg[/img]
[url=https://discord.gg/mNgsQQXzpd][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38391122/8a59d8b4fd12eafc86d6ac97c71a88434692c635.png[/img][/url]

[GAMER Plan]"It was a human." is now on sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2484160/

"It was a human." is a short SF psychedelic interrogation adventure game that focuses on the interrogation of a suspect in a dismemberment murder case.

The game's setting begins with a murder that occurred in a hotel in Kase City, Saga Prefecture. When the police arrived, they discovered the bodies of two unidentified men. The cause of death for each was presumed to be traumatic shock due to blunt force trauma and asphyxiation, respectively. Also, at the scene, a woman suspected to be the perpetrator, Okoze Isana, was found standing with a coping saw in hand. The investigation team considers her to be the murderer in the dismemberment case.

The protagonist of this game is a lieutenant colonel in the military, tasked with interrogating the suspect, Okoze Isana. The protagonist needs to find out why she killed the two men and how she committed the crime.

Okoze Isana might use sweet words or flirtatious glances towards the protagonist during the interrogation, but she is considered a villain and virtually a criminal. The condemnation of her is the objective of this game.

[h2]★COMING SOON★[/h2]

notes.title: [Resistance of the Succubus] Preview of the 1.0 Version Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38391122/ad40b83ac6ae9974ea32a85a85b3fc0f2904d447.jpg[/img]
[url=https://discord.gg/yW54Vr6Q8Q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38391122/8a59d8b4fd12eafc86d6ac97c71a88434692c635.png[/img][/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868000/_/

we are thrilled to announce that the official version of Resistance of the Succubus is almost complete and will be a major and exciting update!

Complete Optimization: We've optimized all the game's art assets to deliver an even more refined visual experience and smoother gameplay.

Brand New Mode: We've removed the Endless Mode and replaced it with an entirely new one - the Nightmare Abyss.

Magic Skill: We introduce a new form of SKill - Magic Skill. These allow players to actively cast spells during battles, altering the course of combat. Master these powerful abilities and unleash dazzling spells!

Free DLC: We're also releasing a brand new free DLC - "Succubus Incarnate." This DLC features a rich 100,000-word narrative and unique gameplay elements.

New Skills: In addition to Spell Abilities, we've introduced multiple brand new skills, offering more options for your battle strategies.

Challenge yourself in the Nightmare Abyss with the new skills and stand alongside Ling Guang City to fend off the looming threat!

[h2]New Free DLC - "Succubus Incarnate."[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38391122/8894302481eaf12e0ef5bd533c5035f1d7cfb567.jpg[/img]
The DLC unfolds the tale of Celine, a resolute female knight, after she transforms into a succubus. As a knight, Celine has always upheld her convictions and sense of justice. However, what if she possesses the power to subjugate and enchant others? With a mere flick of her finger, she could make humans submit, and with a single word, they would devotedly follow her. Could she remain true to herself?

After completing the main storyline, you can choose to play the "Succubus Incarnate" DLC by selecting it in one of the three modes available: Story Mode, Nightmare Abyss, or Succubus Incarnate. In the "Succubus Incarnate" DLC, you'll gain access to a unique buff called "Succubus Power."

Succubus Power: Celine, as a succubus, wields immense power, reducing the cooldown of Magic Skill by one turn and increasing their damage by 30%. Additionally, reaching the maximum desire value won't lead to game over, but each use of a Magic Skill will cost an extra 5 desire points.

Embark on a captivating journey as Celine, where her unwavering spirit and newfound powers intertwine, presenting a fascinating exploration of her character and the choices she makes.

[h2]New Mode: Nightmare Abyss[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38391122/f18f33b6e0153f25e9a651addcb69ca9f145ebfe.png[/img]
Upon completing the main story, you'll unlock a new mode - the Nightmare Abyss. This mode offers various levels of challenges, with increasing difficulty as you progress through the layers.

Your mission in the Nightmare Abyss is to build your army and withstand the onslaught of demonic forces. If you can endure for 40 days, you'll be rewarded handsomely and unlock access to higher layers of the abyss.

The highest layer you can challenge is your current record plus five layers. For example, if your current record is Layer 10, you can attempt to conquer up to Layer 15.

[h2]New Skills Added[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38391122/78be114d82617cb80ff1783ca0be529dc1cf0841.jpg[/img]
Magic Skill is an entirely new category of abilities, obtained similarly to regular skills through scroll draws or dust synthesis. During battles, you can activate the skill indicator by clicking with your mouse or using the number keys on your keyboard. Time your left-click skillfully to unleash the ability and sway the tide of combat.
[h3]New Magic Skill[/h3]
Explosive Flame: Deals 200 damage to enemies in a small area. Cooldown: 1 turn.

Life Shield: Small area allies gain a shield and 100 health. Cooldown: 1 turn.

Hammer of Magic: Deals 100 damage to enemies in a small area, permanently increasing skill damage by 10% for each enemy killed. Cooldown: 3 turns.

Mana Shield: Small area allies gain a shield of 50 mana and 10% of their max health. Cooldown: 2 turns.

Reap and Repent: Deals 300 + 20% of the enemy's lost health as damage, gaining 5 Hope for each enemy killed. Cooldown: 3 turns.

Dark Curse: Inflicts [Curse] on medium-range enemies, increasing damage taken by 20% and dealing an additional 50 damage per second for 8 seconds. Cooldown: 2 turns.

Bloom of Life: Reduces damage taken by medium-range allies by 10% and restores 3% of lost health per second for 6 seconds. Cooldown: 3 turns.

Bloodlust: Increases the attack speed of allied units by 50% for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 2 turns.

Annihilating Flash: Deals 600 + 60% of the enemy's lost health as damage. Cooldown: 4 turns.

[h3]New other skill[/h3]
Energy Overflow: Reduces the cooldown of the third magic skill used each turn by 1 turn.

Arrogance: Increases magic skill damage by 20%. Each magic skill cast in a turn further increases magic skill damage by 20%, stacking up to 3 times.

Solitary Mage: When there are no active bonds of 5 or more people on the field, reduce the cooldown of your magic skills by 1 turn. (Minimum cooldown is 1 turn.)

Malicious Hex: Consume 200 gold. At the start of the battle, [Curse] all enemies, increasing damage taken by 15% for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 1 turn.

notes.title: 【联合发行】青春科幻视觉小说「秋空回忆 -命运的地平线-」！
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38391122/48f04471ee7fc64fd223cc1e207ff10972939abb.png[/img]

由日本独立游戏制作团队GALEX SOFT开发、“与患有“青春失陷症”的少女再一次讴歌青春”的青春SF视觉小说《秋空回忆-命运的地平线》将由mirai works与御宅计划联合发行国际中文版！

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2795550

[h2]◤游戏概况◢[/h2]
■游戏类别：以『校园剧×SF』为主旨的青春科幻视觉小说。
■游戏时长：2-4小时
■语音　　：全语音
■主题曲　：「超弦理论のシックザイル」/ 演唱：遥

[h2]◤游戏剧情◢[/h2]
这是一所没有体育节，只有文化部的寄宿学校，
就读于此的新太，过着普普通通的校园生活。
在他的身边，有一位关系不错每天提供叫醒服务的同桌，一位洒脱且不拘小节的损友，一位认真的班级委员，以及一位个性自由的老师。

但这平静且祥和的生活，却让新太觉得缺乏刺激而感到沮丧。
就在这个不太可能有波澜发生的时节，一名转校生出现在他的班级——

随着学园祭的临近，新太和朋友们满怀喜悦期待着青春的最后时刻，
但某个疾病忽然在全校师生间开始蔓延……

notes.title: 《醋意乱流》将由OTAKU Plan联合发行官方中文版！
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38391122/c1720462d310f7bcda28ca928890e9fb4e8a3881.png[/img]

「醋意乱流」是由madosoft（まどそふと）制作的学园喜剧纯爱体裁作品。
本次Steam版由mirai works与OTAKU Plan联合发行。

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1346770/_/

本作为madosoft旗下第2弹，曾荣获日本萌系游戏大赏金赏与宣发赏。

作为一款融合了★病娇妹妹，★傲娇青梅竹马，★白毛学姐，★金发猫系萝莉的GALGAME大作，虽然发售时日较早，但直至今日，毫不逊色的美术与饱满的剧情仍让旧人渴望回味，让新人趋之若鹜。
而且在当今日本GALGAME游戏公司或是倒闭，或是纷纷转行做页游手游ASMR的大环境下，madosoft是仅存的依旧保持初心制作GALGAME的一家公司。

游戏即将上线，还请各位在期待中等待作品的到来。

[h1]别忘了在[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/otakuplan]发行商主页[/url]点击关注获得御宅计划的一手资讯哦！[/h1]

[h1]简介[/h1]
帝国开拓岛阿雷提亚。憧憬着成为冒险者的年轻少女「希露」，来到了这里，故事由此拉开序幕。
这里有碧绿的平原，广阔的大海，炎热的火山。

作为冒险者活跃的希露，与关系要好的同伴们度过着和平快乐的每一天。
然而，异变的空气悄然来临……。

谁也未曾料到希露将会遭遇怎样的危机。

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442059/ca29ba50cc73b258889e17135f8d3a03a51e5c03.png[/img]
由日本著名的小黄油开发商Flying Panjandrum（ふらいんぐパンジャンドラム）所带来的《四国志 ～酒池肉面战记～》确定发售！

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1379900/

[h1] 简介 [/h1]
本游戏以日本的四国为舞台，男主角则是浦岛太郎的弟弟浦岛次郎。
次郎也和他哥哥一起来到了龙宫。在龙宫，时间的流逝会比人间慢上很多。当次郎从龙宫返回到人间时曾经的时代已然变成了现代社会！
凭借着从龙宫带回的巨大资产，浦岛次郎过足了土豪瘾，还当上了因乌冬面而闻名全日本的香川县的知事。
然而资产却在他的挥霍下见底了，为了能够避免香川县的财政危机（也为了美女和美食），浦岛只能在副知事女木鬼姫的辅佐下，展开了统一四国的霸业！
